args.message: Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix FIN-212: round_money should use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` to return `2.67` instead of `2.66`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switched the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior (per FIN-212).

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` has passed.
